subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw keep the dependency-provided multiline behavior as the documented TUI contract, or add an OpenClaw-owned configurable send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: The immediate documentation gap is narrow, but adding a configurable keybinding would create a new public configuration and compatibility surface that should not be chosen by automation.

options.title: Document the existing behavior
options.body: Add TUI guide and in-product shortcut help that explain the dependency-provided modified-Enter behavior, terminal limitations, and available fallback without adding configuration.

options.title: Sponsor a configurable TUI keybinding
options.body: Define an explicit supported preference, preserve existing Enter-to-send behavior on upgrade, and add focused input, help, and configuration coverage.

recommendation.title: Document the existing behavior
recommendation.body: Add TUI guide and in-product shortcut help that explain the dependency-provided modified-Enter behavior, terminal limitations, and available fallback without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior TUI review and feature-history evidence place this decision closest to the current TUI ownership path.
